summary: Tested Feb-2026 iteration (OG share previews, daily WhatsApp digest, real social links) + full regression. Backend: 15/18 pytest passed (83%). All 3 failures share ONE root cause: GET /share/{id} is NOT reachable through the public ingress (only /api/* is proxied to backend:8001) — the entire public share-preview feature is broken end-to-end. OG image generation (/api/og/{id}.png), digest generation/idempotency, cron auth and all frontend flows (digest page, links, mobile nav, detail share, regression) pass.

critical.issue: Route is defined on the FastAPI app WITHOUT the /api prefix, so the k8s ingress serves it from the frontend (port 3000) instead of the backend. Public GET https://<host>/share/opp-005 returns 200 with the generic React index.html (site-wide og:title only, NO per-opportunity og:image/og:url) and /share/nonexistent-id returns 200 instead of 404. Works only on http://localhost:8001/share/opp-001. Consequence: every WhatsApp/Facebook link produced by the app renders a generic card, and a recipient clicking it lands on a BLANK page (header+footer only, no /share route and no catch-all in App.js) — no redirect to /opportunity/{id}. Fix: move the route to /api/share/{opp_id} (like /api/og) and update OpportunityDetail.jsx share()/shareWhatsApp() accordingly, OR add a /share/:id SPA route that redirects.

og:image / twitter:image are built from request.base_url, which behind the ingress/uvicorn resolves to 'http://localhost:8001/api/og/{id}.png'. Verified: internal response contains og:image content="http://localhost:8001/api/og/opp-001.png". Social crawlers cannot fetch that, so the preview image will never render even after the routing fix. Use the configured public BACKEND_URL/FRONTEND_URL env value (https) instead of request.base_url.

minor.issue: Returns the most recent digest for the device regardless of date (sort by generated_at only, no date filter). If a user visits after not visiting for days, they get a stale digest with expired opportunities instead of today's. Suggest querying {device_id, date: today} and generating on-demand when absent.

server.py hardcodes the preview hostname as the default for FRONTEND_URL/BACKEND_URL (os.environ.get('FRONTEND_URL', 'https://notice-board-17.preview.emergentagent.com')). Env defaults should be omitted so misconfiguration fails fast; this will silently break in production.

App sets 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600' but the preview ingress overwrites it with 'no-store, no-cache'. Infra behaviour, not an app defect — noted only so it isn't chased later. Assertion removed from the test suite.

ui_bugs.issue: No /share/:id SPA route and no catch-all NotFound route — https://<host>/share/opp-005 renders an empty content area between header and footer (verified via screenshot). Any user who clicks a shared link sees a blank page.
'See today's digest' uses <a href="/digest"> instead of react-router <Link>, forcing a full page reload (works, but loses SPA state).

integration_issues.flow: Opportunity Detail -> Share / Send via WhatsApp
integration_issues.issue: Both correctly build ${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/share/{id} and the toast 'Share link copied' fires, but the copied/shared URL is non-functional publicly (see backend CRITICAL #1). The share feature is therefore end-to-end broken despite the UI working.

issues: 'Chat with a human' ghost button renders muted grey text on the dark navy panel with a barely-visible fill — noticeably lower contrast than the two sibling CTAs; looks disabled. Give it the same outlined/light treatment as 'Follow public page'.

action_items: CRITICAL: Re-route the share page under /api (e.g. GET /api/share/{opp_id}) so the ingress proxies it to the backend, and update OpportunityDetail.jsx share()/shareWhatsApp() to use the new path. Verify GET <public>/api/share/nonexistent-id returns 404.
HIGH: In og.py render_share_html, build og:image/twitter:image from the configured public BACKEND_URL env value, not request.base_url (currently emits http://localhost:8001/...).
MEDIUM: Add a /share/:id SPA route (redirect to /opportunity/:id) plus a catch-all 404 route so shared links never land on a blank page.
MEDIUM: Filter GET /api/digest/{device_id} by today's date so users never receive a stale digest.
LOW: Remove hardcoded preview-host defaults for FRONTEND_URL/BACKEND_URL in server.py.
LOW: Use <Link> for pref-view-digest; raise contrast of the 'Chat with a human' CTA.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: any route that must be reachable publicly MUST live under the /api prefix in this environment — /share/{opp_id} silently falls through to the frontend, which is why it 'worked' in the manual localhost smoke test.
og.py: request.base_url is unreliable behind a reverse proxy; derive absolute asset URLs from env config.
digest.py compute_digest_for_prefs takes an unused `db` argument — dead parameter.

_run_digest_job correctly guards on {device_id, date} before insert, so cron is idempotent per day (verified), but there is no unique index on (device_id, date) — two concurrent cron runs could still race. Consider a unique compound index.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_<uuid> device_ids in the preferences + digests collections via API, and one TEST_ report on opp-005. No seeded opportunity data modified.
test_credentials: None required — public app; device_id from localStorage (tnb.deviceId).

Currently only the 3 TestSharePage tests fail, all from the /share routing bug — after the fix, update BASE_URL path in TestSharePage to the new /api/share/{id} and re-run; they should all pass. REGRESSION ALL PASS: discover 12 cards + search 'bursary' -> 1 + filter-cat-tender -> 1 + clear-filters -> 12, card save-btn -> saved page shows the card, business-tenders 3 tabs, Ctrl+K command palette with results, detail Apply link + report dialog submit (reason testids are report-reason-suspected-scam etc.). Correct card testids: opportunity-card-{id}, tender-card-{id}.
rca_of_the_issue: Kubernetes ingress in this environment routes only /api/* to the backend (port 8001); every other path goes to the React dev server (port 3000). GET /share/{opp_id} was registered on the FastAPI app without the /api prefix, so it is never reached from the public URL — the SPA's index.html is returned instead (200 for any id, generic OG tags). Reproduce: curl -s https://<public>/share/opp-001 | grep og:image -> only the site-wide tags; curl http://localhost:8001/share/opp-001 -> correct per-opportunity HTML. Secondary defect surfaced by the same check: the backend-generated HTML sets og:image from request.base_url, yielding http://localhost:8001/api/og/opp-001.png. Mitigation: expose the share page as /api/share/{opp_id}, build absolute image URLs from an env-configured public base URL, and add a /share/:id SPA fallback route.
